what: Unattended VIctory benchmarks of Grand Theft Auto VI (Series X profile) on one Mac, 27 November 2026
mac: MacBook Pro (MacBookPro18,2), Apple M1 Max, 64 GB, macOS 26.6.2, High Power Mode
method: VICTORY_KEYS='2-150/1:Enter' passes the title screen and menus; VICTORY_INPUT_REPLAY holds every stick at 0 so the character stands still in the same scene; VICTORY_BENCH_WARMUP=60 world frames, then VICTORY_BENCH_EXIT_FRAMES=240 measured, then a clean exit. Every run set VICTORY_FAULT_TRACKING=1, VICTORY_PATCH_MASKED=all, VICTORY_ASYNC_SUBMIT=1, VICTORY_STEP_OVER=pool, VICTORY_RAY_TRACING=0, VICTORY_AMBIENT=1, WINEMSYNC=1; 'switches' lists only what a run set beyond that. 'bench' is the report the run wrote; 'world_reports' are medians of the frame-rate lines in its log. A build's first run translates its shaders cold (labels ending in -cold), so compare warm runs. Single runs vary 15% or more with the scene: compare draws too, or ms per draw.
